name: cowork-memory-sync
description: Share Cowork space conversations across machines AND across people, on the macOS and Windows desktop apps. Snapshot a conversation on one machine, catch up on it from another — or from a collaborator's machine. Snapshots are attributed markdown files written into a cloud-synced folder you pick (a OneDrive/iCloud/Dropbox project folder, or a shared SharePoint/Teams library); cross-machine and cross-user propagation is handled by the cloud provider. Spaces can be solo (your machines only) or shared (multiple people), switchable in either direction, with a confirm-before-push gate on shared spaces. No daemon, no MCP, no GitHub.
